frontend_risks.risk: 4 step pills may not fit at current 120px width
frontend_risks.impact: Pills overflow or overlap on narrower screens
frontend_risks.mitigation: Reduce pill width to 95px, reduce gap to 6px. Total: 4*95 + 3*6 = 398px (fits in 800px min width)

frontend_risks.risk: 5 effect modules with 20+ parameters creates cognitive overload
frontend_risks.impact: Users confused by too many controls
frontend_risks.mitigation: 1) All effects start bypassed by default, 2) Provide presets for common use cases, 3) Draggable threshold lines provide visual shortcut

frontend_risks.risk: Effect modules may not fit in control panel height
frontend_risks.impact: Controls cut off or require scrolling
frontend_risks.mitigation: Use compact LinearVertical sliders, reduce module height, consider collapsible modules
frontend_risks.verification: Test layout at minimum window height

frontend_risks.risk: Threshold line drag too small to hit easily
frontend_risks.impact: Frustrating user experience with line selection
frontend_risks.mitigation: Use large hit area (10px above/below line), change cursor on hover, show tooltip during drag

frontend_risks.risk: Waveform update lag during parameter adjustment feels unresponsive
frontend_risks.mitigation: 1) Show processing indicator, 2) Debounce parameter changes (50ms), 3) Use fast preview processing, 4) Show immediate UI feedback (line position) before waveform updates
frontend_risks.verification: Profile update time, ensure < 200ms perceived latency

frontend_risks.risk: User navigates back to Step 2 then forward, losing Step 2.5 settings
frontend_risks.mitigation: Preserve processing settings in memory when navigating between steps. Only reset on file load.

frontend_risks.risk: Multiple threshold lines overlap when thresholds are similar values
frontend_risks.impact: Difficult to distinguish and drag individual lines
frontend_risks.mitigation: 1) Offset lines by 2-3 pixels when within 3dB, 2) Use distinct colors (red/orange/yellow), 3) Show label on hover
frontend_risks.verification: Test with thresholds all set to -12dB

backend_risks.risk: Processing on UI thread blocks interface during long samples
backend_risks.impact: App freezes for seconds during parameter changes
backend_risks.mitigation: MANDATORY: Use background thread (ThreadPool) for processBuffer(). Use AsyncUpdater for safe UI callback.
backend_risks.verification: Test with 60-second sample, verify UI remains responsive

backend_risks.risk: Multiple buffer copies (original, processing, processed) consume excessive memory
backend_risks.mitigation: 1) Only copy when processing starts, 2) Clear processing buffer when done, 3) Process in chunks for very large files
backend_risks.verification: Monitor memory usage with 10-minute audio file

backend_risks.risk: Clicks/pops at buffer boundaries during chunk processing
backend_risks.mitigation: Process entire buffer at once (not streaming). Reset processor state at buffer start.
backend_risks.verification: Audio null test: processed silent input = silent output

backend_risks.risk: Parameter change while processing causes race condition
backend_risks.mitigation: 1) Copy all parameters atomically before processing starts, 2) Use std::atomic for enable flags, 3) Queue parameter changes, apply at processing start
backend_risks.verification: Stress test: rapid slider changes during processing

backend_risks.risk: Corrupt preset file crashes on load
backend_risks.mitigation: 1) Validate JSON before parsing, 2) Use try/catch around file operations, 3) Log errors and load Default preset on failure

backend_risks.impact: Expander sounds wrong or does nothing
backend_risks.mitigation: 1) Follow JUCE Compressor implementation pattern but invert ratio logic, 2) Test with known input (sine wave below threshold should be quieter)
backend_risks.verification: Compare output to reference expander plugin

backend_risks.risk: Gate envelope state machine has edge cases causing clicks
backend_risks.mitigation: 1) Minimum attack/release of 1ms, 2) Smooth transitions with coefficient smoothing, 3) Test with percussive transients
backend_risks.verification: Test gate on drum transients at various thresholds

backend_risks.risk: Processed buffer not correctly passed to Step 3 slice generation
backend_risks.impact: Slicing uses original audio instead of processed
backend_risks.mitigation: Explicit processedBuffer_ member, transitionToStep3FromStep25() sets slicing input buffer
backend_risks.verification: Test: enable heavy compression, verify slices show compressed waveform

backend_risks.risk: Processing large files takes too long for real-time preview feel
backend_risks.mitigation: 1) Process only visible/selected region initially, 2) Process full buffer in background, 3) Show progress indicator

integration_risks.risk: Step numbering change (2.5) confuses users expecting 1,2,3
integration_risks.mitigation: Use clear labels: LENGTH, TEMPO, PROCESS, SLICE (not numbers)

integration_risks.risk: User skips Step 2.5 but expects processing anyway
integration_risks.mitigation: Step 2.5 is mandatory in the flow (can't skip to Step 3 directly). Default preset applies 'bypass all' so effect is neutral.

integration_risks.risk: Threshold slider and threshold line get out of sync
integration_risks.mitigation: Single source of truth in processing service. Both UI elements read from same value. Changes from either update the source.
integration_risks.verification: Test: change slider, verify line moves. Change line, verify slider moves.

integration_risks.mitigation: Update thumbnail on message thread only. Use double-buffering if needed.
integration_risks.verification: Stress test with rapid parameter changes while zoomed in

trigger_conditions: Critical bugs discovered in Step 2.5 affecting Step 3 slicing
Processing too slow to be usable
rollback_steps: 1. Revert WavePreviewPage.h changes (remove Step25 enum and members)
rollback_plan.partial_rollback: If only specific feature fails (e.g., threshold lines), that component can be disabled while keeping core processing

unit_tests: ExpanderProcessor: Verify gain reduction below threshold
integration_tests: Workflow: Navigate back Step 3 -> 2.5 -> 2 -> 1 and forward again
Processing: Parameter change triggers waveform update
Processing: Processed buffer passed correctly to Step 3
Presets: Load factory preset applies all settings
Presets: Save user preset persists to file system
visual_tests: Step pills: All 4 visible and properly colored
Effect modules: All controls visible and functional
Threshold lines: Visible on waveform at correct dB positions
Threshold lines: Draggable with cursor feedback
performance_tests: UI responsiveness: No freeze during processing
audio_quality_tests: Null test: Bypass all = exact input/output match
Gate test: Silent sections properly gated
Compressor test: Peaks reduced by expected ratio
Limiter test: No samples exceed ceiling

BR-008: MUST verify processed buffer flows to Step 3
FR-005: MUST show visual feedback during processing
